name: Prayla · Gremlet #22
description:
A periwinkle mantis that folds its arms and says grace before every single snack.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Prayla in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
